checks.criterion: Does the repo have any AI configuration file? (.cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, .windsurfrules, or any .mdc rule file)
Are there ≥2 distinct rule scope types (alwaysApply:true AND alwaysApply:false)?
Is there a documented rationale for WHEN each rule fires? (AGENTS.md rules section or RULES_STANDARD.md)
Is there per-rule effectiveness data (ablation or eval score per rule)?
Is cross-tool portability documented? (AGENTS.md or equivalent)
Does the repo have any structured task lifecycle? (state.json, issue template, PR checklist, or equivalent)
Is there a hook or structural gate that blocks implementation writes until a contract or spec exists?
Is there an append-only audit log? (breadcrumbs.jsonl or equivalent)
Does machine-readable acceptance-criteria-gated implementation exist — criteria negotiated before any write?
Is there an automated eval regression suite (CI-integrated, not manual runs, with seeded baseline)?
Is there more than one named agent or persona? (≥2 agent definition files)
Are agent roles defined with separate system prompts encoding distinct role identity and output format?
Is there any mechanism limiting what each agent can modify?
Is there trust boundary enforcement — evaluating agent structurally blocked (deny hook) from modifying source files?
Is orchestration programmatic (SDK-based multi-agent launch, not manual /evaluator invocation)?
checks.evidence: library/cursor/hooks/chain-evaluator.sh exists but is phase-advance hook, not SDK-based orchestration

checks.criterion: Are context packages (structured state bundles) passed between agents rather than full history inheritance?
Is there any user-facing guidance on how to prompt the AI? (README, AGENTS.md, example prompts)
Is there a prompt coaching rule or skill that detects underspecified inputs?
Is there any mechanism that loads current task context before the first agent turn?
Is structured context delivery implemented — sessionStart hook injecting current task, open contracts, and recent trace?
Are interaction patterns measured across sessions? (prompt clarity, turns to completion)
checks.evidence: scripts/session-metrics.py exists but output keys are task/breadcrumb counts; turns_to_completion and prompt_clarity not implemented

checks.criterion: Is there prompt versioning with a changelog and per-change hypothesis?
